def world_from_click(x, y, width, height, bounds, zoom, pan_x, pan_y, margin):
    lo, hi, bottom, top = bounds
    scale = min((width-2*margin)/(hi-lo), (height-2*margin)/(top-bottom))*zoom
    if scale <= 0:
        raise ValueError('The map viewport is too small.')
    left=(width-(hi-lo)*scale)/2+pan_x
    upper=(height-(top-bottom)*scale)/2+pan_y
    wx=lo+(x-left)/scale
    wz=top-(y-upper)/scale
    if not lo <= wx <= hi or not bottom <= wz <= top:
        raise ValueError('Click inside the playable map area.')
    return wx,wz





class ObjectMapSession(DensitySession):
    """One unsaved document for placement, deletion, density and Restore."""
    def fork(self):
        other=copy.copy(self)
        other.tree=copy.deepcopy(self.tree)
        other.usage=list(self.usage)
        return other

    def paths(self):
        grid=next(n for n in self.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n)=='PropGrid')
        return [(n.text or '').strip() for n in child(grid,'FileNames')]

    def resolve_instance_ordinal(self, index, position_text):
        """Resolve a rendered map point to its exact instance ordinal."""
        grid = next(n for n in self.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n) == 'PropGrid')
        instances = child(grid, 'Instances')
        if instances is None:
            return None
        return next((
            ordinal for ordinal, node in enumerate(instances)
            if child(node, 'Index') is not None
            and (child(node, 'Index').text or '').strip() == str(index)
            and child(node, 'Position') is not None
            and (child(node, 'Position').text or '').strip() == position_text
        ), None)

    def move_instance(self, ordinal, x, z):
        grid=next(n for n in self.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n)=='PropGrid')
        instances=child(grid,'Instances')
        if not 0<=ordinal<len(instances): raise ValueError('The selected object no longer exists.')
        samples=[position(n) for i,n in enumerate(instances) if i!=ordinal and position(n) is not None]
        nearby=sorted(samples,key=lambda q:(q[0]-x)**2+(q[2]-z)**2)[:8]
        y=(sum(q[1]/max(((q[0]-x)**2+(q[2]-z)**2),.01) for q in nearby)/
           sum(1/max(((q[0]-x)**2+(q[2]-z)**2),.01) for q in nearby)) if nearby else 0.0
        node=instances[ordinal]
        pos=child(node,'Position')
        if pos is None: raise ValueError('The selected object has no Position node.')
        pos.text=f'{x:.8g} {y:.8g} {z:.8g}'
        self.dirty=True
        return y

    def delete_instance(self, ordinal):
        grid=next(n for n in self.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n)=='PropGrid')
        instances=child(grid,'Instances')
        if not 0<=ordinal<len(instances):
            raise ValueError('The selected object no longer exists.')
        instances.remove(instances[ordinal])
        self.usage=usage_counts(self.tree)
        self.dirty=True

    def delete_instances(self, ordinals):
        """Delete multiple instances in one pass and rebuild usage only once."""
        grid = next(n for n in self.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n) == 'PropGrid')
        instances = child(grid, 'Instances')
        if instances is None:
            raise ValueError('Missing RD3D Instances container.')
        unique = sorted({int(value) for value in ordinals}, reverse=True)
        if not unique:
            return 0
        if unique[0] >= len(instances) or unique[-1] < 0:
            raise ValueError('At least one selected object no longer exists.')
        for ordinal in unique:
            instances.remove(instances[ordinal])
        self.usage = usage_counts(self.tree)
        self.dirty = True
        return len(unique)

    def save(self, progress):
        values=self.paths()
        super().save(progress)
        self.cache.values=values
        self.cache.original_values=list(self.cache.original_values)+values[len(self.cache.original_values):]


def preview_placement(session, paths, count, center, bounds, progress, rng=None, area=None, polygon=None):
    """Create a new preview. No cache mutation and no disk writes."""
    if not paths or not isinstance(count,int) or not 1<=count<=10000:
        raise ValueError('Choose an object and a count from 1 to 10000.')
    rng=rng or random.Random()
    result=session.fork()
    grid=next(n for n in result.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n)=='PropGrid')
    names,instances=child(grid,'FileNames'),child(grid,'Instances')
    if names is None or instances is None:raise ValueError('Missing FileNames or Instances.')
    candidates=[(n,position(n)) for n in instances if position(n) is not None]
    if not candidates:raise ValueError('No nearby object positions are available.')
    x,z=center;lo,hi,bottom,top=bounds
    if not lo<=x<=hi or not bottom<=z<=top:raise ValueError('Click inside PlayableArea.')
    if area is not None:
        ax,bx,az,bz=area
        if not lo<=ax<bx<=hi or not bottom<=az<bz<=top:
            raise ValueError('Invalid selected area.')
        # One jittered sample per tile spreads the batch across the rectangle.
        columns=max(1,min(count,math.ceil(math.sqrt(count*(bx-ax)/(bz-az)))))
        rows=math.ceil(count/columns)
        tiles=[(col,row) for row in range(rows) for col in range(columns)]
        # Select tiles spread over the full area even when rows*columns > count.
        tiles=[tiles[min(len(tiles)-1,int((i+.5)*len(tiles)/count))] for i in range(count)]
        rng.shuffle(tiles)
    neighbors=sorted(candidates,key=lambda pair:(pair[1][0]-x)**2+(pair[1][2]-z)**2)[:12]
    # Median local nearest-neighbor distance is robust against distant pairs.
    distances=[]
    for _,p in neighbors:
        nearby=[math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[2]-q[2]) for _,q in neighbors
                if (p[0],p[2])!=(q[0],q[2])]
        if nearby:distances.append(min(nearby))
    typical=sorted(distances)[len(distances)//2] if distances else min(hi-lo,top-bottom)/100
    # World-space center spacing, not an asset bounding-box collision test.
    minimum=max(typical*0.65, min(hi-lo,top-bottom)/1000, 0.05)
    radius=min(max(minimum*math.sqrt(count)*1.5,minimum*2),min(hi-lo,top-bottom)/10)
    buckets={}
    def bucket(px,pz):return math.floor(px/minimum),math.floor(pz/minimum)
    def register(px,pz):buckets.setdefault(bucket(px,pz),[]).append((px,pz))
    for _,p in candidates:register(p[0],p[2])
    def spaced(px,pz):
        bx,bz=bucket(px,pz)
        for dx in (-1,0,1):
            for dz in (-1,0,1):
                for qx,qz in buckets.get((bx+dx,bz+dz),()):
                    if (px-qx)**2+(pz-qz)**2 < minimum**2:return False
        return True
    lookup={v.casefold():i for i,v in enumerate(result.paths())}
    indices=[]
    for path in paths[:count]:
        if path.casefold() not in lookup:
            node=names.makeelement(names[0].tag if len(names) else 'None', {});node.text=path
            node.tail=names[-1].tail if len(names) else '\n'
            lookup[path.casefold()]=len(names);names.append(node)
        indices.append(lookup[path.casefold()])
    occupied={p for _,p in candidates}
    for i in range(count):
        for attempt in range(1000):
            if area is not None:
                col,row=tiles[i]
                nx=ax+(col+rng.random())*(bx-ax)/columns
                nz=az+(row+rng.random())*(bz-az)/rows
                # If a tile is blocked, retry throughout the selected rectangle.
                if attempt>=250:
                    nx,nz=rng.uniform(ax,bx),rng.uniform(az,bz)
                if polygon and not MapViewTemplate.point_in_polygon(nx, nz, polygon):
                    continue
            elif count==1 and attempt==0:nx,nz=x,z
            else:
                angle=rng.random()*math.tau;r=radius*math.sqrt(rng.random())
                nx,nz=x+math.cos(angle)*r,z+math.sin(angle)*r
            nx,nz=round(nx,7),round(nz,7)
            if not lo<=nx<=hi or not bottom<=nz<=top or not spaced(nx,nz):continue
            if area is not None and not (ax<=nx<=bx and az<=nz<=bz):continue
            local=sorted(candidates if area is not None else neighbors,key=lambda pair:(pair[1][0]-nx)**2+(pair[1][2]-nz)**2)[:4]
            weights=[1/max((p[0]-nx)**2+(p[2]-nz)**2,1e-12) for _,p in local]
            y=sum(p[1]*weight for (_,p),weight in zip(local,weights))/sum(weights)
            new=round(nx,7),round(y,7),round(nz,7)
            if new not in occupied:break
        else:raise ValueError(
            f'Not enough space for {count} objects near this point with a minimum spacing of {minimum:.3f}. '
            'No objects were inserted. Choose fewer objects or a larger/different area.')
        occupied.add(new)
        register(new[0],new[2])
        node=copy.deepcopy(local[0][0]);child(node,'Index').text=str(indices[i%len(indices)])
        child(node,'Position').text=' '.join(format(v,'.7f').rstrip('0').rstrip('.').replace('.',',') if v else '0' for v in new)
        instances.append(node)
        if i%50==0:progress(i,count)
    result.usage=usage_counts(result.tree);result.dirty=True
    progress(count,count)
    return result

class PlaceObjectMixin:
    def _place_object_open(self,event,area=None):
        if not self._object_profiles_available(1):return 'break'
        if not self._load_object_configuration_table_1_data():
            messagebox.showinfo('Place Object','The XML cache is loading. Please try again after loading.')
            return 'break'
        cache=self.rd3d_ram_cache
        if any(row[2].get().strip()!=cache.values[row[0]] for row in self.object_configuration_table1_rows):
            messagebox.showwarning('Place Object','Save Objects Table 1 path edits before placing objects.')
            return 'break'
        canvas=self.object_configuration_map_canvas
        try:
            from app.templates.template_map_view import MapViewTemplate
            center=world_from_click(event.x,event.y,canvas.winfo_width(),canvas.winfo_height(),
                self.object_configuration_map_bounds,self.object_configuration_map_shared_zoom,
                self.object_configuration_map_shared_pan_x,self.object_configuration_map_shared_pan_y,MapViewTemplate.MAP_MARGIN)
        except ValueError as exc:

    def _place_toggle_checked(self, event):
        tree = getattr(self, '_place_tree', None)
        if tree is None or tree.identify_region(event.x, event.y) != 'cell':
            return
        if tree.identify_column(event.x) != '#1':
            return
        item = tree.identify_row(event.y)
        key = self._place_tree_rows.get(item)
        if key is None:
            return 'break'
        if key in self._place_checked:
            self._place_checked.remove(key)
            mark = '☐'
        else:
            self._place_checked.add(key)
            mark = '☑'
        values = list(tree.item(item, 'values'))
        values[0] = mark
        tree.item(item, values=values)
        tree.selection_set(tuple(
            iid for iid, row_key in self._place_tree_rows.items()
            if row_key in self._place_checked
        ))
        return 'break'

    def _place_select(self):
        tree = getattr(self, '_place_tree', None)
        checked = [
            key for iid, key in self._place_tree_rows.items()
            if key in self._place_checked
        ]
        if not checked and tree is not None:
            checked = [self._place_tree_rows[iid] for iid in tree.selection()
                       if iid in self._place_tree_rows]
        if not checked:
            messagebox.showwarning(
                'Place Object', 'Check at least one entry in the table first.',
                parent=self._place_window,
            )
            return
        groups = []
        labels = []
        for kind, value in checked:
            paths = (self._object_configuration_database_paths(value)
                     if kind == 'Category' else [value])
            paths = tuple(path for path in paths if path)
            if paths:
                groups.append(paths)
                labels.append(value)
        if not groups:
            messagebox.showwarning(
                'Place Object', 'The checked entries contain no placeable objects.',
                parent=self._place_window,
            )
            return
        self._place_choose(groups, ', '.join(labels))

    def _place_choose(self,path_groups,label):
        if not self._object_profiles_available(1):return
        dialog=ctk.CTkInputDialog(title='Place Object',text=f'{label}\nHow many objects should be inserted? (1-10000)')
        value=dialog.get_input()
        if value is None:return
        try:
            count=int(value.strip())
            if not 1<=count<=10000:raise ValueError()
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showerror('Place Object','Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000.',parent=self._place_window);return
        cache=self._place_cache
        if self.rd3d_ram_cache is not cache:
            messagebox.showerror('Place Object','The island cache changed. Reopen Place Object.');return
        if not self._object_profiles_available(1):return
        if any(row[2].get().strip()!=cache.values[row[0]] for row in self.object_configuration_table1_rows):
            messagebox.showwarning('Place Object','Save Objects Table 1 edits first.');return

        try:
            cache,session=self._map_session_current()
        except ValueError as exc:
            messagebox.showerror('Place Object',str(exc));return
        groups=tuple(tuple(group) for group in path_groups if group)
        area=getattr(self,'_place_area',None);polygon=getattr(self,'_place_polygon',None)
        def work(progress):
            current=session if session is not None else ObjectMapSession(cache)
            rng=random.Random()
            # Round-robin categories gives each checked category either floor(n/k)
            # or ceil(n/k) objects. Each category then chooses a random path.
            chosen=[rng.choice(groups[index % len(groups)]) for index in range(count)]
            rng.shuffle(chosen)
            current=preview_placement(current,chosen,count,center,bounds,progress,rng=rng,area=area,polygon=polygon)
            return current,'place',self._map_preview_points(current)
        self._tmc_ram_begin('RD3D Map Edit',work)



    def _map_session_current(self):
        path = Path(self.rd3d_file_var.get().strip())
        cache = self.rd3d_ram_cache
        if cache is None or cache.path != path:
            if not path.is_file():
                raise ValueError("Please load an existing rd3d_original.xml file first.")
            # Object Map owns an RD3D editing session. Load its current island
            # cache directly instead of showing "Load the cache first".
            cache = Rd3dXmlRamCache(path).load(lambda _done, _total: None)
            self.rd3d_ram_cache = cache
            self.object_configuration_table1_rows = [
                (index, old, tk.StringVar(value=current), count)
                for index, (old, current, count) in enumerate(
                    zip(cache.original_values, cache.values, cache.usage)
                )
            ]
            self._render_object_configuration_table_1()
            self.status_var.set(
                f"Object Map cache loaded: {len(cache.values)} object paths."
            )
        if any(row[2].get().strip()!=cache.values[row[0]] for row in self.object_configuration_table1_rows):
            raise ValueError('Save Objects Table 1 path edits before editing map objects.')
        session=getattr(self,'_map_edit_session',None)
        if session is not None and session.cache is not cache:
            if session.dirty:raise ValueError('The cache changed while map edits were unsaved. Reopen the map.')
            session=None
        if session is not None and session.signature!=cache.signature:
            if session.dirty:raise ValueError('RD3D changed. Save or discard map edits before reloading.')
            session=None
        return cache,session

    def _map_preview_points(self,session):
        categories={i:self._classify_object_configuration_path(path) for i,path in enumerate(session.paths())}
        return session.map_points(categories)

    def _map_edit_run(self,action,ordinal=None):
        try:
            cache,session=self._map_session_current()
            def work(progress):
                current=session.fork() if session is not None else ObjectMapSession(cache)
                if action=='delete':current.delete_instance(ordinal)
                elif action=='restore':current.restore()
                elif action=='save':current.save(progress)
                progress(1,1)
                return current,action,self._map_preview_points(current)
            self._tmc_ram_begin('RD3D Map Edit',work)
        except (ValueError,IndexError) as exc:
            messagebox.showerror('Object Map',str(exc),parent=self.object_configuration_map_window)

    def _map_edit_complete(self,result):
        session,action,points=result[:3]
        if session.cache is not self.rd3d_ram_cache:return
        self._map_edit_session=session
        self._density_session=session
        self._density_cache=session.cache
        self.object_configuration_map_points=points
        self.object_configuration_map_file_names=session.paths()
        self.object_configuration_map_info_var.set(
            f'{len(points)} instances | ' + ('Unsaved object changes' if session.dirty else 'Saved object state')
            + ' | Right click: Add Object')
        for point in points:
            category=point[5]
            self.object_configuration_map_category_visible.setdefault(category,True)
            self.object_configuration_map_category_colors.setdefault(category,self._object_configuration_picker_color(category))
        self._rebuild_object_configuration_map_legend()
        self._schedule_object_configuration_map_redraw()
        if action=='save':
            cache=session.cache
            self.object_configuration_table1_rows=[(i,old,tk.StringVar(master=self,value=cache.values[i]),cache.usage[i])
                for i,old in enumerate(cache.original_values)]
            self._render_object_configuration_table_1()
        self._object_density_refresh()
        if len(result)==5:
            self._map_region_refresh(result[3],result[4])
        else:
            region_window=getattr(self,'_region_window',None)
            if region_window is not None and region_window.winfo_exists():
                region_window.destroy()
                self._region_window=None
        if action == 'delete-region':
            removed = result[3] if len(result) > 3 else 0
            self._map_selection_clear()
            text = (
                f'{removed} object(s) removed from the selected area in memory. '
                'Click Object Map Save to write changes.'
            )
        else:
            text=('Object changes saved to rd3d_patched.xml.' if action=='save' else
                  'Original objects restored in memory. Click Save to write changes.' if action=='restore' else
                  'Object changes updated in memory. Click Save to write changes.')
        self.status_var.set(text)
        self.tmc_ram_info.set(text)
        if action=='save':
            messagebox.showinfo(
                'Object Map',
                'The changes were saved successfully.',
                parent=self.object_configuration_map_window,
            )

    def _map_delete_at(self,event,hit=None):
        if not self._object_profiles_available(1):return True
        if hit is None:
            points=self.object_configuration_map_screen_points
            hit=min(points,key=lambda p:(p[0]-event.x)**2+(p[1]-event.y)**2,default=None)
            if hit is None or (hit[0]-event.x)**2+(hit[1]-event.y)**2>64:return False
        try:
            cache,session=self._map_session_current()
            # Screen point identifies the instance by Index + exact Position text.
            # For overlapping identical objects, delete one occurrence only.
            if not messagebox.askyesno('Remove Object',
                f'Remove this object?\nIndex: {hit[2]}\nPosition: {hit[6]}\n\nChanges remain unsaved until Save.',
                parent=self.object_configuration_map_window,default='no'):return True
            def work(progress):
                current=session.fork() if session is not None else ObjectMapSession(cache)
                grid=next(n for n in current.tree.getroot().iter() if local_tag(n)=='PropGrid')
                instances=child(grid,'Instances')
                ordinal=next((i for i,n in enumerate(instances)
                    if child(n,'Index') is not None and (child(n,'Index').text or '').strip()==str(hit[2])
                    and child(n,'Position') is not None and (child(n,'Position').text or '').strip()==hit[6]),None)
                if ordinal is None:raise ValueError('The selected object no longer exists.')
                current.delete_instance(ordinal);progress(1,1)
                return current,'delete',self._map_preview_points(current)
            if self._object_profiles_available(1):self._tmc_ram_begin('RD3D Map Edit',work)
        except ValueError as exc:messagebox.showerror('Object Map',str(exc))
        return True

===== FILE: app\functions\function_region.py =====
"""Detect an island's original region from MapSource/SourceMap.

Only the path stored inside the map XML is inspected. The referenced .a7me
file does not need to exist. No XML or texture files are modified.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


REGION_NAMES = {
    "moderate": "The Old World",
    "colony01": "The New World",
    "colony02": "Enbesa",
    "colony03": "Arctic",
    "scenario03": "The Old World",
    "scnenario03": "The Old World",  # Accepted spelling from configuration.
    "scenario02": "Enbesa Scenario02",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RegionInfo:
    source_map: str = ""
    region_key: str = ""
    region_name: str = ""


def region_from_source_map(source_map: str) -> RegionInfo:
    """Match complete path components, ignoring case and slash direction."""
    source_map = str(source_map or "").strip()
    parts = [p.casefold() for p in re.split(r"[\\/]+", source_map) if p]
    # Match folders only, not incidental substrings inside an island filename.
    keys = {part for part in parts[:-1] if part in REGION_NAMES}
    names = {REGION_NAMES[key] for key in keys}
    if len(names) != 1:
        return RegionInfo(source_map=source_map)
    key = next(part for part in parts[:-1] if part in keys)
    return RegionInfo(source_map, key, REGION_NAMES[key])


def region_from_xml_root(root) -> RegionInfo:
    """Read SourceMap, including XML documents with namespaces."""
    paths = []
    for element in root.iter():
        if str(element.tag).rsplit("}", 1)[-1] == "SourceMap":
            text = (element.text or "").strip()
            if text:
                paths.append(text)
    if not paths:
        return RegionInfo()
    infos = [region_from_source_map(path) for path in paths]
    if len(set(paths)) > 1:
        # Do not silently select one of several conflicting source paths.
        return RegionInfo()
    return infos[0]


def read_region(mapname_original_xml, parser=None) -> RegionInfo:
    """Read a map XML. Optional parser may return the app's (tree, ..., ...) tuple.

    Missing files and malformed XML raise exceptions for standalone callers.
    The application mixin below records errors without interrupting loading.
    """
    path = Path(mapname_original_xml)
    parsed = parser(path) if parser is not None else ET.parse(path)
    tree = parsed[0] if isinstance(parsed, tuple) else parsed
    root = tree.getroot() if hasattr(tree, "getroot") else tree
    return region_from_xml_root(root)


class RegionDetectionMixin:
    """Keep original-region metadata synchronized with the selected map XML."""

    def _initialize_region_detection(self):
        self.original_region_info = RegionInfo()
        self.original_region_name = ""
        self.original_region_key = ""
        self.original_source_map = ""
        self.original_region_error = ""
        self._region_path_trace = self.mapname_file_var.trace_add(
            "write", self._refresh_original_region
        )
        self._refresh_original_region()

    def _refresh_original_region(self, *_args):
        # Clear first: missing/unknown files must not retain the previous island.
        info = RegionInfo()
        self.original_region_error = ""
        path = self.mapname_file_var.get().strip()
        if path:
            try:
                info = read_region(path, parser=self._parse_xml_tolerant)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.original_region_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        self.original_region_info = info
        self.original_region_name = info.region_name
        self.original_region_key = info.region_key
        self.original_source_map = info.source_map
        for method_name in ("_update_texture_detected_region", "_update_regional_detected_region"):
            update_display = getattr(self, method_name, None)
            if callable(update_display):
                update_display()
        return info

===== FILE: app\functions\function_slot_validation.py =====
"""Pure XML validation and export gate for island slot integration.

This module intentionally has no Tk dependency. It validates single resource slots
and paired river slots before patched XML is installed or exported.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
import math
import app.backend.xml_backend as ET
from app.config.config_slot import RIVER_GUID_FAMILIES, RIVER_GUID_ROLE, SINGLE_SLOT_GUIDS


@dataclass
class SlotGateReport:
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    river_pairs: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    checked_map_entries: int = 0

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return not self.errors

    def require_ok(self) -> "SlotGateReport":
        if self.errors:
            raise ValueError("Slot validation failed:\n- " + "\n- ".join(self.errors))
        return self


def local_tag(node):
    return node.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] if isinstance(node.tag, str) else ""


def direct(node, name):
    target = name.casefold()
    return next((child for child in list(node) if local_tag(child).casefold() == target), None)


def direct_text(node, name, default=""):
    child = direct(node, name)
    return (child.text or "").strip() if child is not None else default


def parse_position(value):
    parts = (value or "").replace(";", " ").split()
    if len(parts) != 3:
        raise ValueError(f"Position must contain three values: {value!r}")
    result = tuple(float(part.replace(",", ".")) for part in parts)
    if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in result):
        raise ValueError(f"Position contains non-finite values: {value!r}")
    return result


def close_position(a, b, tolerance=0.05):
    return all(abs(x - y) <= tolerance for x, y in zip(a, b))


def game_records(root):
    records = {}
    for parent in root.iter():
        for node in list(parent):
            object_id = direct_text(node, "ID")
            guid = direct_text(node, "guid")
            position = direct_text(node, "Position")
            if not (object_id and guid and position):
                continue
            if object_id in records:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate Gamedata ID {object_id}.")
            records[object_id] = {
                "id": object_id,
                "guid": guid,
                "position": parse_position(position),
                "folder": direct_text(node, "ObjectFolderID"),
                "node": node,
            }
    return records


def map_records(root):
    records = {}
    category = None
    slot_blocks = [node for node in root.iter() if local_tag(node) == "SlotObjects"]
    if len(slot_blocks) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected exactly one SlotObjects block, found {len(slot_blocks)}.")
    for block in list(slot_blocks[0]):
        value = direct(block, "value")
        if value is not None:
            category = direct_text(value, "id")
            continue
        for node in list(block):
            object_id = direct_text(node, "ObjectId")
            if not object_id:
                continue
            record = {
                "id": object_id,
                "guid": direct_text(node, "ObjectGuid"),
                "position": parse_position(direct_text(node, "Position")),
                "category": category,
                "node": node,
            }
            previous = records.get(object_id)
            if previous and (previous["guid"], previous["position"], previous["category"]) != (record["guid"], record["position"], record["category"]):
                raise ValueError(f"Conflicting duplicate MapName ObjectId {object_id}.")
            records.setdefault(object_id, record)
    return records


def bezier_points(node):
    points = []
    for child in node.iter():
        if local_tag(child) == "p" and (child.text or "").strip():
            points.append(parse_position(child.text))
    return points


def bezier_bounds(node):
    minimum = next((parse_position(child.text) for child in node.iter() if local_tag(child) == "Minimum" and (child.text or "").strip()), None)
    maximum = next((parse_position(child.text) for child in node.iter() if local_tag(child) == "Maximum" and (child.text or "").strip()), None)
    return minimum, maximum


def has_bezier(node):
    return any(local_tag(child) == "BezierCurve" for child in node.iter())


def bounds_contain(points, minimum, maximum, tolerance=0.05):
    return minimum is not None and maximum is not None and all(
        minimum[i] - tolerance <= point[i] <= maximum[i] + tolerance
        for point in points for i in range(3)
    )


def _structural_custom_match(primary, workarea):
    points = bezier_points(workarea["node"])
    if len(points) < 2:
        return False
    endpoints = (points[0], points[-1])
    return (
        (close_position(endpoints[0], workarea["position"]) and close_position(endpoints[1], primary["position"]))
        or (close_position(endpoints[1], workarea["position"]) and close_position(endpoints[0], primary["position"]))
    )


def resolve_river_pairs(game, map_data, report=None):
    """Resolve usable River pairs without validating or reporting River findings."""
    pairs = []
    used = set()
    for family_name, family in RIVER_GUID_FAMILIES.items():
        primaries = [record for record in game.values() if record["guid"] == family["primary"]]
        workareas = [record for record in game.values() if record["guid"] == family["workarea"]]
        for primary in primaries:
            if family.get("folder_pairing") and primary["folder"]:
                matches = [
                    work for work in workareas
                    if work["folder"] == primary["folder"] and work["id"] not in used
                ]
            else:
                folder_matches = [
                    work for work in workareas
                    if primary["folder"] and work["folder"] == primary["folder"]
                    and work["id"] not in used
                ]
                matches = folder_matches if len(folder_matches) == 1 else [
                    work for work in workareas
                    if work["id"] not in used and _structural_custom_match(primary, work)
                ]
            if len(matches) != 1:
                continue
            work = matches[0]
            used.update((primary["id"], work["id"]))
            if primary["id"] in map_data and work["id"] in map_data:
                pairs.append((primary["id"], work["id"], family_name))
    return pairs


def validate_native_deposit(record, report):
    """Validate the runtime fields required by the working C# deposit templates."""
    node = record["node"]
    object_id = record["id"]
    guid = record["guid"]
    if direct_text(node, "ObjectFolderID") != "0":
        report.errors.append(f"Native deposit {object_id} ({guid}) must use ObjectFolderID 0.")
    participant = direct(node, "ParticipantID")
    if participant is None or direct_text(participant, "id") != "8":
        report.errors.append(f"Native deposit {object_id} ({guid}) must use ParticipantID 8.")
    mesh = direct(node, "Mesh")
    flags = direct(mesh, "Flags") if mesh is not None else None
    sequence = direct(mesh, "SequenceData") if mesh is not None else None
    if flags is None or direct_text(flags, "flags") != "1":
        report.errors.append(f"Native deposit {object_id} ({guid}) must use Mesh/Flags/flags 1.")
    if sequence is None or direct_text(sequence, "CurrentSequenceStartTime") != "0":
        report.errors.append(f"Native deposit {object_id} ({guid}) must use CurrentSequenceStartTime 0.")
    for component in ("Blocking", "Building", "QuestObject", "Infolayer", "RandomMapObject", "Selection", "SoundEmitter"):
        if direct(node, component) is None:
            report.errors.append(f"Native deposit {object_id} ({guid}) is missing <{component}>.")
    sound = direct(node, "SoundEmitter")
    if sound is not None and direct_text(sound, "TimeBudget") != "500":
        report.errors.append(f"Native deposit {object_id} ({guid}) must use SoundEmitter/TimeBudget 500.")

def validate_slot_trees(map_root, game_root, strict_deposit_ids=None) -> SlotGateReport:
    report = SlotGateReport()
    strict_deposit_ids = {str(value) for value in (strict_deposit_ids or ())}
    try:
        game = game_records(game_root)
        mapped = map_records(map_root)
    except ValueError as exc:
        report.errors.append(str(exc))
        return report
    report.checked_map_entries = len(mapped)

    # Cross-file integrity applies uniformly to every object listed in MapName
    # SlotObjects, including River primary/work-area objects. River-specific
    # pair/category/Bezier validation remains disabled.
    for object_id, entry in mapped.items():
        record = game.get(object_id)
        if record is None:
            report.errors.append(f"MapName ObjectId {object_id} has no Gamedata object.")
            continue
        if record["guid"] != entry["guid"]:
            report.errors.append(
                f"GUID mismatch for ObjectId {object_id}: "
                f"MapName {entry['guid']} / Gamedata {record['guid']}."
            )
        if not close_position(record["position"], entry["position"], tolerance=0.000001):
            report.errors.append(f"Position mismatch for ObjectId {object_id}.")
        if entry["guid"] in SINGLE_SLOT_GUIDS and entry["category"] != "1":
            report.errors.append(
                f"Single resource slot {object_id} ({entry['guid']}) must be in category 1."
            )
        # Original game files legitimately contain several runtime variants of
        # GUID 100417/100849. Enforce the canonical creation template only for
        # deposits generated in the current editing session.
        if object_id in strict_deposit_ids and entry["guid"] in {"100417", "100849"}:
            validate_native_deposit(record, report)

    # Detect the reverse missing-counterpart case for known slot families. The
    # complete Gamedata also contains many non-slot objects, so only configured
    # slot GUIDs can be checked safely in this direction.
    river_guids = {
        str(guid)
        for family in RIVER_GUID_FAMILIES.values()
        for guid in (family["primary"], family["workarea"])
    }
    known_slot_guids = {str(guid) for guid in SINGLE_SLOT_GUIDS} | river_guids
    for object_id, record in game.items():
        if record["guid"] in known_slot_guids and object_id not in mapped:
            report.errors.append(
                f"Gamedata ObjectId {object_id} ({record['guid']}) has no MapName object."
            )

    # Metadata-only River pairing. This emits no River errors or warnings.
    report.river_pairs = resolve_river_pairs(game, mapped, report)
    return report


def validate_slot_export_files(map_path, game_path) -> SlotGateReport:
    map_root = ET.parse(Path(map_path)).getroot()
    game_root = ET.parse(Path(game_path)).getroot()
    return validate_slot_trees(map_root, game_root)

VALID_GATE_STAGES = frozenset({"save", "finalize", "pack"})


def validate_slot_gate(stage, map_path, game_path) -> SlotGateReport:
    """Run the same strict file gate at Save, Finalize or Pack boundaries."""
    stage = str(stage).strip().casefold()
    if stage not in VALID_GATE_STAGES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown slot gate stage {stage!r}; expected save, finalize or pack.")
    try:
        report = validate_slot_export_files(map_path, game_path)
    except (OSError, ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        report = SlotGateReport(errors=[f"{stage.capitalize()} gate could not read slot XML: {exc}"])
    if report.errors:
        report.errors = [f"[{stage}] {error}" for error in report.errors]
    if report.warnings:
        report.warnings = [f"[{stage}] {warning}" for warning in report.warnings]
    return report

===== FILE: app\functions\function_xml_repair.py =====
"""Lossless handling of source characters unsupported by the XML parser.

Unsupported source bytes, forbidden XML 1.0 characters and invalid numeric
references are temporarily represented by valid private-use tokens. ElementTree
can then edit the document. ElementTree.write is wrapped once so those tokens are
restored byte-for-byte when the tree is saved. Structural XML errors are never
ignored or reconstructed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import re
import app.backend.xml_backend as ET
_TOKEN_START = 0xF0000
_TOKEN_END = 0xFFFFD
_INVALID_REF = re.compile(r"&#(?:x([0-9A-Fa-f]+)|([0-9]+));")
_INVALID_REF_BYTES = re.compile(br"&#(?:x([0-9A-Fa-f]+)|([0-9]+));")
_INVALID_CONTROL_BYTES = re.compile(br"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]")
def _valid_xml_codepoint(value: int) -> bool:
    return (
        value in (0x9, 0xA, 0xD)
        or 0x20 <= value <= 0xD7FF
        or 0xE000 <= value <= 0xFFFD
        or 0x10000 <= value <= 0x10FFFF
    ) and value != 0xFFFD


def _tokenize_unsupported_bytes(raw: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes]]:
    """Fast path for the ASCII references/control bytes found in Anno XML."""
    preserved: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    counter = 0

    def token(value: bytes) -> bytes:
        nonlocal counter
        if _TOKEN_START + counter > _TOKEN_END:
            raise ValueError("Too many unsupported XML fragments to preserve.")
        placeholder = chr(_TOKEN_START + counter)
        counter += 1
        preserved[placeholder] = value
        return placeholder.encode("utf-8")

    def replace_reference(match):
        try:
            value = int(match.group(1), 16) if match.group(1) is not None else int(match.group(2), 10)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return match.group(0)
        return match.group(0) if _valid_xml_codepoint(value) else token(match.group(0))

    masked = _INVALID_REF_BYTES.sub(replace_reference, raw)
    masked = _INVALID_CONTROL_BYTES.sub(lambda match: token(match.group(0)), masked)
    return masked, preserved


def _tokenize_unsupported(text: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, bytes]]:
    """Replace parser-hostile source fragments with unique valid XML tokens."""
    preserved: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    counter = 0

    def token(raw: bytes) -> str:
        nonlocal counter
        if _TOKEN_START + counter > _TOKEN_END:
            raise ValueError("Too many unsupported XML fragments to preserve.")
        value = chr(_TOKEN_START + counter)
        counter += 1
        preserved[value] = raw
        return value

    def replace_reference(match):
        try:
            value = int(match.group(1), 16) if match.group(1) is not None else int(match.group(2), 10)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return match.group(0)
        if _valid_xml_codepoint(value):
            return match.group(0)
        return token(match.group(0).encode("ascii"))

    text = _INVALID_REF.sub(replace_reference, text)
    result = []
    for char in text:
        codepoint = ord(char)
        if 0xDC80 <= codepoint <= 0xDCFF:
            # Produced by UTF-8 surrogateescape: preserve the exact original byte.
            result.append(token(bytes((codepoint - 0xDC00,))))
        elif _valid_xml_codepoint(codepoint):
            result.append(char)
        else:
            result.append(token(char.encode("utf-8", errors="surrogatepass")))
    return "".join(result), preserved


def sanitize_xml_text(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Compatibility API: mask unsupported content without deleting it."""
    masked, preserved = _tokenize_unsupported(text)
    return masked, len(preserved)


def parse_xml_tolerant(path):
    """Parse XML while preserving parser-hostile original content losslessly."""
    path = Path(path)
    raw = path.read_bytes()

    # Anno XML commonly contains invalid numeric references inside otherwise
    # valid UTF-8. Mask them before parsing. This avoids one failed full parse
    # and avoids walking very large HeightMap/terrain text character by character.
    masked_bytes, preserved = (raw, {})
    if b"&#" in raw:
        masked_bytes, preserved = _tokenize_unsupported_bytes(raw)
    if preserved:
        try:
            root = ET.fromstring(masked_bytes)
        except (ET.ParseError, OSError):
            # Continue with the general encoding-aware fallback below.
            pass
        else:
            tree = ET.ElementTree(root)
            tree._xml_preserved_tokens = preserved
            tree._xml_source_encoding = "bytes"
            return tree, True, len(preserved)

    try:
        return ET.parse(path), False, 0
    except (ET.ParseError, OSError) as original_error:
        if raw.startswith((b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff")):
            encoding = "utf-16"
            text = raw.decode(encoding, errors="surrogatepass")
        elif raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
            encoding = "utf-8-sig"
            text = raw.decode(encoding, errors="surrogateescape")
        else:
            encoding = "utf-8"
            text = raw.decode(encoding, errors="surrogateescape")
        masked, preserved = _tokenize_unsupported(text)
        if not preserved:
            raise original_error
        try:
            root = ET.fromstring(masked)
        except (ET.ParseError, OSError):
            raise original_error
        tree = ET.ElementTree(root)
        tree._xml_preserved_tokens = preserved
        tree._xml_source_encoding = encoding
        return tree, True, len(preserved)
===== END FILE: app\functions\function_xml_repair.py =====

===== FILE: app\functions\functions_tintmaps.py =====
"""Region-aware patching of island tintmap DDS files.

The patcher intentionally supports DXT1/BC1 tintmaps only. It keeps a byte-for-byte
backup beside every changed file and always rebuilds from that backup, so changing
regional settings repeatedly never applies corrections cumulatively.
Converted combinations are cached beside the tintmaps folder and reused by copy.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import os
import hashlib
import json
import threading
import shutil
import struct
import tempfile
import time

from PIL import Image

REGIONS = ("Old World", "New World", "Enbesa", "Arctic")
BACKUP_SUFFIX = ".tintmap_original"
PATCH_STATE_FILENAME = "tintmap_patch_state.json"
PATCH_ROUTINE_VERSION = 2

# Additional RGB offsets applied after the regional conversion.
# Change these constants to tune the Brightness presets globally.
BRIGHTER_RGB_OFFSET = (12, 12, 12)
DARKER_RGB_OFFSET = (-12, -12, -12)
BRIGHTNESS_OPTIONS = ("Normal", "Brighter", "Darker")
_BRIGHTNESS_OFFSETS = {
    "Normal": (0, 0, 0),
    "Brighter": BRIGHTER_RGB_OFFSET,
    "Darker": DARKER_RGB_OFFSET,
}
# Keep CPU-bound Python compression from monopolizing the GUI interpreter.
TINTMAP_MAX_WORKERS = 4
TINTMAP_YIELD_SECONDS = 0.001

# Robust median/IQR profiles calculated from the supplied tintmap analysis.
# Values are file-level RGB means. The mapper aligns source median/spread with
# target median/spread and blends by pair-specific strength.
_PROFILES = {
    "Old World": ((129.485, 110.567, 128.352), (3.738, 41.327, 5.382)),
    "New World": ((128.655, 112.172, 128.758), (1.600, 32.630, 1.805)),
    "Enbesa": ((128.625, 107.870, 128.624), (0.855, 19.235, 0.852)),
    "Arctic": ((131.400, 131.120, 131.022), (1.027, 4.249, 5.749)),
}

_STRENGTH = {
    frozenset(("Old World", "New World")): 0.40,
    frozenset(("Old World", "Enbesa")): 0.70,
    frozenset(("New World", "Enbesa")): 0.70,
    frozenset(("Old World", "Arctic")): 0.75,
    frozenset(("New World", "Arctic")): 0.75,
    frozenset(("Enbesa", "Arctic")): 0.65,
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TintmapPatchResult:
    tintmaps_folder: Path
    found: int
    changed: int
    restored: int
    skipped: int
    failed: int
    errors: tuple[str, ...]


def find_tintmaps_folder(a7m_path: str | Path, status_callback=None) -> Path:
    """Resolve root/_gamedata/<mapname>/tintmaps case-insensitively."""
    a7m = Path(a7m_path)
    if status_callback is not None:
        status_callback("folder", "Checking selected island file", str(a7m))
    if not a7m.is_file() or a7m.suffix.casefold() != ".a7m":
        raise FileNotFoundError("Select an existing .a7m island file first.")
    gamedata_root = a7m.parent / "_gamedata"
    if status_callback is not None:
        status_callback("folder", "Locating _gamedata folder", str(gamedata_root))
    if not gamedata_root.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"_gamedata folder not found: {gamedata_root}")
    if status_callback is not None:
        status_callback("folder", "Locating island map folder", a7m.stem)
    map_folder = next(
        (p for p in gamedata_root.iterdir()
         if p.is_dir() and p.name.casefold() == a7m.stem.casefold()),
        None,
    )
    if map_folder is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Map folder not found below _gamedata: {a7m.stem}"
        )
    if status_callback is not None:
        status_callback("folder", "Locating tintmaps folder", str(map_folder))
    tintmaps = next(
        (p for p in map_folder.iterdir()
         if p.is_dir() and p.name.casefold() == "tintmaps"),
        None,
    )
    if tintmaps is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Tintmaps folder not found: {map_folder / 'tintmaps'}")
    if status_callback is not None:
        status_callback("folder_found", "Tintmaps folder found", str(tintmaps))
    return tintmaps


def _dds_format(path: Path) -> str:
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        header = stream.read(148)
    if len(header) < 128 or header[:4] != b"DDS ":
        return "INVALID"
    fourcc = header[84:88].rstrip(b"\0").decode("ascii", "replace")
    if fourcc == "DX10" and len(header) >= 148:
        dxgi = struct.unpack_from("<I", header, 128)[0]
        return "BC1" if dxgi in (71, 72) else f"DXGI_{dxgi}"
    return "DXT1" if fourcc == "DXT1" else (fourcc or "UNCOMPRESSED")


def _rgb565(rgb):
    r, g, b = rgb
    return ((r * 31 + 127) // 255 << 11) | ((g * 63 + 127) // 255 << 5) | ((b * 31 + 127) // 255)


def _from565(value):
    return (
        ((value >> 11) & 31) * 255 // 31,
        ((value >> 5) & 63) * 255 // 63,
        (value & 31) * 255 // 31,
    )


def _encode_dxt1_block(pixels):
    # Select endpoints along the block's luminance range. For opaque tintmaps
    # endpoint0 must be greater than endpoint1 to force DXT1 four-colour mode.
    darkest = min(pixels, key=lambda c: 2126*c[0] + 7152*c[1] + 722*c[2])
    lightest = max(pixels, key=lambda c: 2126*c[0] + 7152*c[1] + 722*c[2])
    c0, c1 = _rgb565(lightest), _rgb565(darkest)
    if c0 == c1:
        c0 = min(65535, c0 + 1) if c0 < 65535 else c0
        c1 = max(0, c1 - 1) if c0 == c1 else c1
    if c0 < c1:
        c0, c1 = c1, c0
    p0, p1 = _from565(c0), _from565(c1)
    palette = (
        p0, p1,
        tuple((2*p0[i] + p1[i]) // 3 for i in range(3)),
        tuple((p0[i] + 2*p1[i]) // 3 for i in range(3)),
    )
    indices = 0
    for i, pixel in enumerate(pixels):
        index = min(range(4), key=lambda j: sum((pixel[k]-palette[j][k])**2 for k in range(3)))
        indices |= index << (2*i)
    return struct.pack("<HHI", c0, c1, indices)


def _encode_dxt1(rgb: Image.Image) -> bytes:
    width, height = rgb.size
    if width % 4 or height % 4:
        raise ValueError(f"DXT1 dimensions must be divisible by four: {width}x{height}")
    pixels = rgb.load()
    output = bytearray()
    for by in range(0, height, 4):
        time.sleep(TINTMAP_YIELD_SECONDS)
        for bx in range(0, width, 4):
            block = [pixels[bx+x, by+y] for y in range(4) for x in range(4)]
            output.extend(_encode_dxt1_block(block))
    return bytes(output)


def _transform_image(image: Image.Image, source_region: str, target_region: str, brightness: str) -> Image.Image:
    source_median, source_iqr = _PROFILES[source_region]
    target_median, target_iqr = _PROFILES[target_region]
    strength = _STRENGTH.get(frozenset((source_region, target_region)), 0.65)
    rgb = image.convert("RGB")
    # The transformation is channel-independent. Build exact 256-value lookup
    # tables instead of running a Python loop for every pixel.
    scales = [max(0.25, min(4.0, target_iqr[i] / source_iqr[i])) for i in range(3)]
    brightness_offset = _BRIGHTNESS_OFFSETS[brightness]
    lut = []
    for i in range(3):
        for value in range(256):
            matched = target_median[i] + (value - source_median[i]) * scales[i]
            converted = value * (1.0 - strength) + matched * strength
            lut.append(max(0, min(255, round(converted + brightness_offset[i]))))
    return rgb.point(lut)


def _patch_one(path: Path, source_region: str, target_region: str, brightness: str) -> str:
    backup = path.with_name(path.name + BACKUP_SUFFIX)
    if source_region == target_region and brightness == "Normal":
        if backup.is_file():
            shutil.copy2(backup, path)
            return "restored"
        return "skipped"
    source = backup if backup.is_file() else path
    fmt = _dds_format(source)
    if fmt not in {"DXT1", "BC1"}:
        return f"skipped:{fmt}"
    if not backup.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, backup)
    with source.open("rb") as stream:
        raw = stream.read()
    header_size = 148 if raw[84:88] == b"DX10" else 128
    with Image.open(source) as decoded:
        transformed = _transform_image(decoded, source_region, target_region, brightness)
    payload = _encode_dxt1(transformed)
    expected = transformed.width * transformed.height // 2
    if len(payload) != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected DXT1 payload size: {len(payload)} != {expected}")
    # Tintmaps in the supplied set have one mipmap. Refuse other layouts rather
    # than silently discarding levels that the game may need.
    mipmaps = struct.unpack_from("<I", raw, 28)[0] or 1
    if mipmaps != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"DDS has {mipmaps} mipmaps; only one-level tintmaps are supported")
    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + ".", suffix=".tmp", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as temp:
            temp.write(raw[:header_size])
            temp.write(payload)
        os.replace(temp_name, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temp_name):
            os.unlink(temp_name)
    return "changed"



def _sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


class _PatchState:
    """Persist successful per-file operations; never trust a stale file hash."""

    def __init__(self, folder):
        self.folder = folder
        self.path = folder / PATCH_STATE_FILENAME
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.entries = {}
        if self.path.exists():
            try:
                data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if data.get("schema") != 1 or not isinstance(data.get("files"), dict):
                    raise ValueError("Unsupported patch state format")
                self.entries = data["files"]
                for entry in self.entries.values():
                    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not all(
                        key in entry for key in ("source_region", "target_region", "version", "sha256")
                    ):
                        raise ValueError("Invalid patch state entry")
            except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid tintmap patch state: {self.path}: {exc}") from exc

    def store(self, key, entry):
        with self.lock:
            updated = dict(self.entries)
            if entry is None:
                updated.pop(key, None)
            else:
                updated[key] = entry
            fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="tintmap_state_", suffix=".tmp", dir=self.folder)
            try:
                with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                    json.dump({"schema": 1, "files": updated}, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                os.replace(temporary, self.path)
                self.entries = updated
            finally:
                if os.path.exists(temporary):
                    os.unlink(temporary)

    def patch(self, path, source_region, target_region, brightness):
        key = path.relative_to(self.folder).as_posix()
        with self.lock:
            entry = self.entries.get(key)
        backup = path.with_name(path.name + BACKUP_SUFFIX)
        if entry is not None:
            if _sha256(path) != entry["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Conflict: DDS was externally modified; file was not overwritten")
            if not backup.is_file():
                raise ValueError("Conflict: original backup is missing; file was not overwritten")

        # Preserve originals even for identity selections. Never convert an active
        # variant: all new variants are derived from this immutable source.
        if not backup.is_file():
            _atomic_copy(path, backup)
        original_hash = _sha256(backup)
        identity = source_region == target_region and brightness == "Normal"
        if identity:
            if _sha256(path) == original_hash:
                self.store(key, None)
                return "skipped:Original already active"
            _atomic_copy(backup, path)
            self.store(key, None)
            return "restored"

        if _dds_format(backup) not in {"DXT1", "BC1"}:
            return "skipped:Unsupported DDS format"
        region_codes = {"Old World": "ow", "New World": "nw",
                        "Enbesa": "enbesa", "Arctic": "arctic"}
        variant_name = (f"{region_codes[source_region]}_to_{region_codes[target_region]}"
                        f"__{brightness.lower()}")
        # Outside tintmaps: the normal DDS scan cannot discover cached variants.
        cache_root = self.folder.parent / "_tintmap_variants" / variant_name
        cached = cache_root / key
        metadata = cached.with_name(cached.name + ".cache.json")
        expected = {"source_region": source_region, "target_region": target_region,
                    "brightness": brightness, "version": PATCH_ROUTINE_VERSION,
                    "original_sha256": original_hash}
        valid = False
        if cached.is_file() and metadata.is_file():
            try:
                data = json.loads(metadata.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                valid = (isinstance(data, dict)
                         and all(data.get(k) == v for k, v in expected.items())
                         and data.get("sha256") == _sha256(cached))
            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
                valid = False
        reused = valid
        if not valid:
            cached.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            # Stage away from active files. Failed conversion leaves active DDS
            # and previously stored variants untouched.
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tintmap_variant_", dir=cached.parent) as tmp:
                staged = Path(tmp) / path.name
                shutil.copy2(backup, staged)
                result = _patch_one(staged, source_region, target_region, brightness)
                if result != "changed":
                    return result
                _atomic_copy(staged, cached)
            _atomic_json(metadata, dict(expected, sha256=_sha256(cached)))
        digest = _sha256(cached)
        if _sha256(path) == digest:
            state = "skipped:Variant already active"
        else:
            _atomic_copy(cached, path)
            state = "changed:Copied cached variant" if reused else "changed:Created and applied variant"
        self.store(key, {"source_region": source_region, "target_region": target_region,
                         "brightness": brightness, "version": PATCH_ROUTINE_VERSION,
                         "sha256": digest})
        return state


def _atomic_copy(source, destination):
    """Replace one file only after its complete copy is available."""
    destination = Path(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=destination.name + ".", suffix=".tmp",
                                     dir=destination.parent)
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        shutil.copy2(source, temporary)
        os.replace(temporary, destination)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def _atomic_json(destination, data):
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=destination.name + ".", suffix=".tmp",
                                     dir=destination.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(data, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, destination)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)

def patch_island_tintmaps(
        a7m_path, source_region, target_region, brightness="Normal",
        workers=None, progress_callback=None):
    if source_region not in REGIONS or target_region not in REGIONS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown source or target region.")
    if brightness not in BRIGHTNESS_OPTIONS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown brightness option.")
    folder = find_tintmaps_folder(a7m_path, status_callback=progress_callback)
    if progress_callback is not None:
        progress_callback("scan_start", "Scanning tintmaps folder for DDS files", str(folder))
    files = []
    scanned = 0
    for path in folder.rglob("*"):
        scanned += 1
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix.casefold() == ".dds":
            files.append(path)
        if progress_callback is not None and (scanned == 1 or scanned % 100 == 0):
            progress_callback("scan", scanned, len(files), str(path))
    files.sort(key=lambda p: str(p).casefold())
    if progress_callback is not None:
        progress_callback("scan_done", scanned, len(files), str(folder))
    if not files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No DDS files found below: {folder}")
    patch_state = _PatchState(folder)
    worker_count = max(1, min(int(workers or TINTMAP_MAX_WORKERS), TINTMAP_MAX_WORKERS, len(files)))
    counts = {"changed": 0, "restored": 0, "skipped": 0, "failed": 0}
    errors = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=worker_count, thread_name_prefix="Tintmap") as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(patch_state.patch, p, source_region, target_region, brightness): p for p in files}
        completed = 0
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            path = futures[future]
            try:
                state = future.result()
                counts[state.split(":", 1)[0]] += 1
            except Exception as exc:
                state = "failed"
                counts["failed"] += 1
                errors.append(f"{path}: {exc}")
            completed += 1
            if progress_callback is not None:
                progress_callback("patch", completed, len(files), path, state)
    return TintmapPatchResult(folder, len(files), counts["changed"], counts["restored"],
                              counts["skipped"], counts["failed"], tuple(errors))

def get_app_dir() -> Path:
    """Return the persistent application directory.

    In a normal Python run this is the directory containing the .py file.
    In a PyInstaller build this is the directory containing the launched .exe,
    not PyInstaller's temporary extraction directory.
    """
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        return Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


APP_DIR = get_app_dir()

def get_bundle_dir() -> Path:
    """Return the directory containing bundled read-only resources.

    In a PyInstaller onefile build this is the temporary extraction directory
    (sys._MEIPASS). During a normal Python run it is the script directory.
    """
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False) and hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):
        return Path(sys._MEIPASS).resolve()
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

def read_local_version() -> str:
    try:
        value = VERSION_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").strip()
        return value or "unknown"
    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
        return "unknown"

def version_key(version: str):
    """Create a numeric comparison key from versions such as 0.69.12 or v0.69.12."""
    parts = re.findall(r"\d+", (version or "").strip())
    return tuple(int(part) for part in parts) if parts else ()

    def _start_version_check(self):
        """Check the published version without blocking the Tk UI."""
        threading.Thread(target=self._version_check_worker, daemon=True).start()

    def _version_check_worker(self):
        if APP_VERSION == "unknown":
            return
        try:
            request = urllib.request.Request(
                REMOTE_VERSION_URL,
                headers={"User-Agent": f"Anno-Island-Tool/{APP_VERSION}"},
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=4) as response:
                remote_version = response.read(256).decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace").strip()
        except (OSError, urllib.error.URLError, ValueError):
            # Version checks are optional. Startup continues silently when offline.
            return
        current_key = version_key(APP_VERSION)
        remote_key = version_key(remote_version)
        if current_key and remote_key and remote_key > current_key:
            self.after(0, lambda: self._show_update_available(remote_version))





    def _save_gamedata_object_changes(self, window):
        original = Path(self.gamedata_file_var.get().strip())
        if not original.is_file():
            messagebox.showerror("Gamedata Objects", "gamedata_original.xml is not available.", parent=window)
            return

        guid_changes = {}
        for id_var, guid_var in window.object_edit_rows:
            object_id = id_var.get().strip()
            new_guid = guid_var.get().strip()
            if not object_id or not new_guid:
                messagebox.showerror("Gamedata Objects", "ID and GUID values must not be empty.", parent=window)
                return
            guid_changes[object_id] = new_guid

        try:
            # Always rebuild gamedata_patched.xml from the complete original.
            tree, _, _ = self._parse_xml_tolerant(original)
            root = tree.getroot()
            gamedata_changed = 0
            for parent in root.iter():
                children = list(parent)
                id_node = next((c for c in children if isinstance(c.tag, str) and c.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1].lower() == "id"), None)
                guid_node = next((c for c in children if isinstance(c.tag, str) and c.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1].lower() == "guid"), None)
                object_id = (id_node.text or "").strip() if id_node is not None else ""
                if object_id in guid_changes and guid_node is not None:
                    new_guid = guid_changes[object_id]
                    if (guid_node.text or "").strip() != new_guid:
                        guid_node.text = new_guid
                        gamedata_changed += 1

            gamedata_patched = original.with_name("gamedata_patched.xml")
            tree.write(gamedata_patched, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=False, short_empty_elements=True)

            mapname_original = Path(self.mapname_file_var.get().strip())
            mapname_patched = None
            mapname_changed = 0
            if mapname_original.is_file():
                map_tree, _, _ = self._parse_xml_tolerant(mapname_original)
                map_root = map_tree.getroot()
                for parent in map_root.iter():
                    children = list(parent)
                    id_node = next((c for c in children if isinstance(c.tag, str) and c.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1].lower() == "objectid"), None)
                    guid_node = next((c for c in children if isinstance(c.tag, str) and c.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1].lower() == "objectguid"), None)
                    object_id = (id_node.text or "").strip() if id_node is not None else ""
                    if object_id in guid_changes and guid_node is not None:
                        new_guid = guid_changes[object_id]
                        if (guid_node.text or "").strip() != new_guid:
                            guid_node.text = new_guid
                            mapname_changed += 1
                map_tmp = mapname_patched.with_suffix(mapname_patched.suffix + ".tmp")
                map_tree.write(map_tmp, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=False, short_empty_elements=True)
                self._parse_xml_tolerant(map_tmp)
                map_tmp.replace(mapname_patched)

        except (OSError, ET.ParseError, UnicodeError) as exc:
            messagebox.showerror("Gamedata Objects", f"The changes could not be saved:\n{exc}", parent=window)
            return

        text = (
            "Object changes saved.\n\n"
            f"Gamedata: {gamedata_patched.name}\n"
            f"Changed GUID entries: {gamedata_changed}"
        )
        if mapname_patched is not None:
            text += f"\n\nMap file: {mapname_patched.name}\nChanged ObjectGuid entries: {mapname_changed}"
        else:
            text += "\n\nNo mapname_original.xml was selected, so no map file was written."
        self.status_var.set(f"Objects saved: {gamedata_changed} GUID change(s)")
        messagebox.showinfo("Gamedata Objects", text, parent=window)


    @staticmethod
    def _collect_gamedata_objects(root):
        """Return every sibling ID/GUID pair in source order."""
        rows = []
        for parent in root.iter():
            object_id = None
            guid = None
            for child in list(parent):
                if not isinstance(child.tag, str):
                    continue
                tag = child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1].lower()
                if tag == "id":
                    object_id = (child.text or "").strip()
                elif tag == "guid":
                    guid = (child.text or "").strip()
            if object_id and guid:
                rows.append((object_id, guid))
        return rows


    @staticmethod

        """Compatibility wrapper for the shared XML character sanitizer."""
        return sanitize_xml_text(text)

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_xml_tolerant(path: Path):
        """Compatibility wrapper for the shared tolerant XML parser."""
        return parse_xml_tolerant(path)

    def _select_gamedata_file(self):

            filetypes=[("gamedata_original.xml", "gamedata_original.xml"), ("XML", "*.xml")],

    def _autodetect_mapname_original(self, gamedata_path: Path):
        """Find <mapname>_original.xml one folder above gamedata_original.xml."""
        gamedata_path = Path(gamedata_path)
        if not gamedata_path.is_file():
            return

        # Expected layout:
        # X:\mapname\mapname_original.xml
        # X:\mapname\mapname\gamedata_original.xml
        #
        # Therefore the map XML is in the parent of the folder containing
        # gamedata_original.xml.
        data_folder = gamedata_path.parent
        search_folder = data_folder.parent
        if not search_folder.is_dir():
            return

        # Usually the inner data folder has the map name.
        map_name = data_folder.name
        expected = search_folder / f"{map_name}_original.xml"
        if expected.is_file():
            self.mapname_file_var.set(str(expected))
            return

        # Also try the outer folder name for layouts where both names differ.
        outer_name = search_folder.name
        expected_outer = search_folder / f"{outer_name}_original.xml"
        if expected_outer.is_file():
            self.mapname_file_var.set(str(expected_outer))
            return

        # Fallback only when there is exactly one plausible *_original.xml.
        candidates = [
            candidate for candidate in search_folder.glob("*_original.xml")
            if candidate.name.lower() not in {
                "gamedata_original.xml",
                "rd3d_original.xml",
                "a7minfo_original.xml",
            }
        ]
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            self.mapname_file_var.set(str(candidates[0]))

    def _select_mapname_file(self):
        initial = Path(self.gamedata_file_var.get().strip()).parent.parent if self.gamedata_file_var.get().strip() else None
        value = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Select mapname_original.xml",
            initialdir=str(initial) if initial and initial.is_dir() else None,
            filetypes=[("mapname_original.xml", "*_original.xml"), ("XML", "*.xml")],
        )
        if value:
            self.mapname_file_var.set(value)

    @staticmethod
    def _dropdown_display_for_value(options, xml_value, current_display):
        """Return the configured dropdown display label for an XML value."""
        xml_value = (xml_value or "").strip()
        if not xml_value:
            return current_display
        for display, value in options.items():
            if value == xml_value:
                return display
        # Keep dropdown configuration authoritative: if a patched XML contains
        # a value unknown to config_gamedata.py, retain the current valid item.
        return current_display

    def _update_gamedata_dropdowns_from_patched(self, original_path: Path):
        """Update New content dropdowns from gamedata_patched.xml when available."""
        patched_path = Path(original_path).with_name("gamedata_patched.xml")
        if not patched_path.is_file():
            return
        try:
            tree, _, _ = self._parse_xml_tolerant(patched_path)
        except (ET.ParseError, OSError, UnicodeError):
            return

        ambient = None
        vegetation = None
        for element in tree.getroot().iter():
            if not isinstance(element.tag, str):
                continue
            tag = element.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
            value = (element.text or "").strip()
            if tag == "GlobalAmbientName" and value and ambient is None:
                ambient = value
            elif tag == "VegetationPropSetName" and value and vegetation is None:
                vegetation = value
            if ambient is not None and vegetation is not None:
                break

        if ambient is not None:
            self.new_global_ambient_var.set(
                self._dropdown_display_for_value(
                    GLOBAL_AMBIENT_OPTIONS, ambient, self.new_global_ambient_var.get()
                )
            )
        if vegetation is not None:
            self.new_vegetation_var.set(
                self._dropdown_display_for_value(
                    VEGETATION_PROP_SET_OPTIONS, vegetation, self.new_vegetation_var.get()
                )
            )

    def _load_gamedata_xml(self, show_errors=True):
        self._xml_loading_depth += 1
        try:
            self._xml_loading_show('Reading gamedata XML...')
            return self._load_gamedata_xml_with_progress_body(show_errors=show_errors)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._xml_loading_finish(str(exc))
            raise
        finally:
            self._xml_loading_depth -= 1
            self._xml_loading_finish()

    def _load_gamedata_xml_with_progress_body(self, show_errors=True):
        path = Path(self.gamedata_file_var.get().strip())
        if path.is_file() and not self.mapname_file_var.get().strip():
            self._autodetect_mapname_original(path)
        if not path.is_file():
            self.global_ambient_var.set("-")
            self.vegetation_prop_set_var.set("-")
            if show_errors:
                messagebox.showerror("Gamedata", "Please select an existing gamedata_original.xml file.")
            return False
        try:
            tree, repaired, repairs = self._parse_xml_tolerant(path)
            root = tree.getroot()
            repair_note = ""
            if repaired:
                repair_note = f" | preserved unchanged: {repairs} unsupported XML item(s)"
            values = {"GlobalAmbientName": [], "VegetationPropSetName": []}
            for element in root.iter():
                tag = element.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
                if tag in values:
                    text = (element.text or "").strip()
                    if text and text not in values[tag]:
                        values[tag].append(text)
            self.global_ambient_var.set("\n".join(values["GlobalAmbientName"]) or "Not found")
            self.vegetation_prop_set_var.set("\n".join(values["VegetationPropSetName"]) or "Not found")
            self._update_gamedata_dropdowns_from_patched(path)
            self.status_var.set(f"Gamedata loaded: {path.name}{repair_note}")
            return True
        except (ET.ParseError, OSError) as exc:
            self.global_ambient_var.set("Error while reading")
            self.vegetation_prop_set_var.set("Error while reading")
            self.status_var.set(f"Gamedata blocked: {path.name} | {exc}")
            if show_errors:
                if isinstance(exc, ET.ParseError):
                    details = self._format_xml_parse_error(path, exc)
                else:
                    details = f"File: {path}\nRead error: {exc}"
                messagebox.showerror(
                    "Gamedata XML blocked",
                    "The Gamedata XML is structurally invalid and was not loaded.\n"
                    "No patched XML can be generated from this input.\n\n" + details,
                )
            return False

    @staticmethod
    def _insert_xml_child_preserve_layout(parent, element, after_tags=()):
        """Insert a child while preserving the surrounding FileDBReader XML whitespace."""
        children = list(parent)
        insert_at = None
        for preferred in after_tags:
            insert_at = next(
                (index + 1 for index, child in enumerate(children)
                 if isinstance(child.tag, str)
                 and child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] == preferred),
                None,
            )
            if insert_at is not None:
                break

        # ElementTree stores indentation in .text/.tail. Copy the indentation
        # pattern from neighboring children so the new element stays on its own line.
        child_indent = None
        if children:
            for child in children:
                if child.tail and "\n" in child.tail:
                    child_indent = child.tail
                    break
        if child_indent is None:
            child_indent = "\n      "

        if insert_at is None:
            insert_at = len(children)

        if insert_at < len(children):
            next_child = children[insert_at]
            element.tail = child_indent
            parent.insert(insert_at, element)
        else:
            # When appending, the old final child owns the parent's closing-tag
            # indentation. Transfer that tail to the new final child and give
            # the old final child normal sibling indentation.
            closing_indent = "\n    "
            if children and children[-1].tail:
                closing_indent = children[-1].tail
                children[-1].tail = child_indent
            element.tail = closing_indent
            parent.append(element)

    def _save_gamedata_patch(self):
        """Update the latest complete Gamedata state without losing slot edits."""
        original = Path(self.gamedata_file_var.get().strip())
        if not original.is_file():
            messagebox.showerror(
                "Gamedata",
                "Please load an existing gamedata_original.xml file first.",
            )
            return False

        ambient_display = self.new_global_ambient_var.get()
        vegetation_display = self.new_vegetation_var.get()
        ambient = GLOBAL_AMBIENT_OPTIONS.get(ambient_display)
        vegetation = VEGETATION_PROP_SET_OPTIONS.get(vegetation_display)

        if not ambient or not vegetation:
            messagebox.showerror("Gamedata", "The selected values are invalid.")
            return False

        patched_file = original.with_name("gamedata_patched.xml")
        # Regional Settings must extend the latest patched state. Falling back to
        # gamedata_original.xml is allowed only before the first patched save.
        source_file = patched_file if patched_file.is_file() else original

        try:
            # Load the complete latest XML. This preserves Slot Map objects and
            # every other edit already stored in gamedata_patched.xml.
            tree, repaired, repairs = self._parse_xml_tolerant(source_file)
            root = tree.getroot()

            ambient_count = 0
            vegetation_count = 0

            # Change only the requested elements. Everything else remains in
            # the loaded XML tree and is written to the patched output.
            for element in root.iter():
                tag = element.tag
                if isinstance(tag, str) and "}" in tag:
                    tag = tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]

                if tag == "GlobalAmbientName":
                    element.text = ambient
                    ambient_count += 1
                elif tag == "VegetationPropSetName":
                    element.text = vegetation
                    vegetation_count += 1

            vegetation_inserted = False
            if ambient_count == 0:
                messagebox.showerror(
                    "Gamedata",
                    "GlobalAmbientName was not found in the current Gamedata XML.",
                )
                return False

            if vegetation_count == 0:
                # VegetationPropSetName is optional. Insert it in the native
                # Content/GameSessionManager/SessionSettings location.
                session_settings = None
                for content in root.iter():
